issue.title: Bob Mac Capture: dangling - * Work Log pending copy and protocol.md mention
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). After bob-cli ships `- * <text>` Work Log star bullets, a dangling `x` plus `- *` reaches CapturePanelModel's pending row with separator `*`, so it currently reads `Type a task number after *`. Change that pending copy to `Type the Work Log entry for the remaining tasks`. Also mention `- *` in the Mac `docs/protocol.md` close-log paragraph. Nothing else in the app needs to change: the `*` chip reuses `pomodoro_close_log_index`, extra JSON keys decode harmlessly, and the close card previews star entries through the dry run's per-row `typed_work_log`.

plan:202611/close_log_star_bullet.md implements the bob-cli lexer, resolver, JSON/human output, tests, and docs. It explicitly files this Mac copy-plus-docs change as a follow-up and forbids editing mounted `docs/reference/mac-capture/*`.
